lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters are organized into three primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a high-contrast pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, particularly in the mid-flank region, intersecting with the large circular blobs to form a grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Distinct horizontal linear features are observed on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow-defined edge on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense distribution of high-frequency, small-diameter speckles is present across the cephalic region, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced blobs posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
